description: Apply for your Myanmar visa from the UK. We complete and check your application and documents before submitting, so nothing delays your trip.
intro: British passport holders need a visa to visit Myanmar (Burma), which can be applied for online as an eVisa. We complete your Myanmar visa application and check every detail before submitting it. Choose the visa that matches your trip below.
eligibility: Your passport is valid for at least 6 months from the date you arrive
You are travelling for tourism, business meetings, transit or to visit family or friends
You have a return or onward ticket and enough money for your stay

sections.heading: Do British citizens need a Myanmar visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Myanmar (Burma), which can be applied for online as an eVisa.

sections.heading: Myanmar visa for other passport holders
sections.text: UK residents on other passports usually apply the same way.

sections.heading: UK government travel advice for Myanmar
sections.text: The UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) advises against travel to parts of Myanmar because of the security situation. Please read the latest advice on GOV.UK before making plans, as it may affect your travel insurance.

sections.heading: Myanmar visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Myanmar visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. We check the current rules for your nationality, complete your application and keep you updated until it's approved. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Myanmar.

faqs.q: Does the UK government advise against travel to Myanmar?
faqs.a: The FCDO advises against travel to parts of Myanmar. Check the latest advice on GOV.UK before you book.

faqs.q: How long does a Myanmar visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.

faqs.q: Can you apply for my Myanmar visa for me?
faqs.a: Yes. Use our online form: upload your passport and we fill in your details, then we complete and check the Myanmar visa application and submit it for you.
